notes.title: Sharing Lights release on March 4th!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903080/Sharing_Lights/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38840243/3eaedb0180e55f415f2e8e66054a1b985b8551d8.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Welcome to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903080/Sharing_Lights/]Sharing Lights[/url]![/h2]

Enter a strange and dark dungeon designed by the best architect of the entire Kingdom. Firstly created to protect the King's most precious treasures, it is now used as an overly intricated maze where no one ever escaped before. To ensure the dungeon's secrets never unveil, the architect herself has been captured and locked inside her best creation. Find her, and you might have a chance to get out...

Play 4 innocent Ghosts at the same time, manage the light and maybe, find the exit.

[h3]FEATURES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 32 levels are waiting for the smartest people to complete.
[*] Multiple ways to solve the puzzle.
[*] Easy mechanics, it's a game for your brain.
[*] Dark dungeon mood.
[*] 11 achievments unlocking alongside your progression.
[/list]

notes.title: Astria Update : Game Fixes and Improved User Experience
notes.content:
Game Fix:
- Locked stepper could lead to a sotlock.
- Wrong cube respawn
- Cube not respawning.

User Experience :
- Improved collisions for rocks : player should not slip from it anymore.
- Improved explanations for the Energy Puzzle. A more complete description is now available ingame.
- A small indicator was added to allow to player to know if the trigger inside a wall is already active. This will help a lot to remember what you have already done!
- New feedback message when an element is not active anymore.

Level Changes : 
- Floor 9, Floor 11, Floor 12 and the Catacysme have been changed (minor modification).

Achievement:
- Achievement for the Cataclysm is now working.
